title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Role: Analytics Architect

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Full Time


Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.

Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.

Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.

Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.

Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.

Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.

Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).

Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.

Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.

Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.

Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Experience:

Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Customer Service Technical Support
description:
Company Description

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. At Kyniska, we are committed to enabling professional growth and creating impactful employment connections.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional. Responsibilities include delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing customer experience through proficient problem-solving and communication. The individual will handle customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat, troubleshoot technical issues, and work diligently to resolve customer concerns while maintaining professional and empathetic interaction.

Qualifications
  • Strong skills in Customer Service and Customer Support, ensuring the ability to manage and resolve client inquiries efficiently.
  • Expertise in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience, with a focus on delivering solutions to improve customer relationships.
  • Proficiency in Phone Etiquette and effective communication skills, providing a professional and empathetic approach to customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while being a collaborative team player.
  • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: IT SAP Support Coordinator
description:
Hello, candidate :)


About Us: Würth IT, a dynamic and forward-thinking IT organization within the Würth Group, is growing its team in Brazil. We are looking for dedicated professionals to join us as part of our global network, working together to deliver cutting-edge IT solutions that enhance security, efficiency, and reliability. As a member of the Würth IT team, you’ll collaborate with colleagues worldwide, providing specialized support and promoting the innovative IT services we offer. Your work will play a crucial role in strengthening the operations of Würth Group companies across the globe, driving impactful results within a supportive and growth-oriented environment.


Your main activities:

We are seeking a Local SAP 2nd & 3rd Level Support Coordinator to work at our site in Cotia, São Paulo.

You will be part of an international and innovative team that values diversity, development, and collaboration. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and high-performing commerce applications.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the local SAP 2nd & 3rd Level Support Team
  • Work operational 50% of the available time in resolving 2nd LS tickets
  • Ensure compliance with local requirements (labor law, office presence, local processes)
  • Responsible for salary and contract matters, local onboarding processes, and employee well-being
  • Support local personnel development and feedback processes
  • Manage and monitor KPIs and SLAs in SAP support
  • Promote innovation and continuous improvement within the team
  • Act as an interface to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work closely with the functional manager to align technical goals and feedback loops
  • Foster team spirit and local corporate culture


Requirements:

  • Fluent in English.
  • Willingness to work at least 3 days per week on site in Cotia.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in the SAP environment
  • Deep technical knowledge in one of these areas: SD, WM/EWM, MM or FI
  • Proven experience in leading teams, ideally in a local context.
  • Experience in stakeholder management and working with international teams
  • Knowledge of ITIL and agile methods is a plus
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, assertiveness, and intercultural competence

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

description:

Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.

Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.

Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.

Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Experience:

Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.




Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida vivência em ambientes desafiadores e dinâmicos, especialmente no setor financeiro. Este profissional atuará de forma estratégica e operacional em projetos de dados, sendo responsável por desenhar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis que suportem tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atividades do dia a dia:


Desenvolver e manter fluxos de ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados, garantindo que as informações estejam acessíveis, íntegras e atualizadas para os usuários de negócio.

Trabalhar em conjunto com analistas, cientistas de dados e equipes de negócio, compreendendo suas necessidades e traduzindo essas demandas em soluções de dados viáveis e eficientes.

Modelar dados estruturados e não estruturados, assegurando sua organização, governança e consistência ao longo dos projetos.

Garantir a qualidade dos dados, implementando processos de validação, auditoria e monitoramento contínuo.

Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à performance, falhas de pipeline e inconsistências nos dados, atuando de forma proativa para evitar recorrências.

Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio aplicadas nas soluções desenvolvidas, promovendo a transparência e facilitando a manutenção dos sistemas de dados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas e de alinhamento com stakeholders, comunicando de forma clara os avanços, riscos e limitações dos projetos em andamento.

Adaptar-se rapidamente a novos contextos e demandas, demonstrando curiosidade e iniciativa para aprender novas abordagens, padrões e boas práticas.


Python (Avançado )

Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.




Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida vivência em ambientes desafiadores e dinâmicos, especialmente no setor financeiro. Este profissional atuará de forma estratégica e operacional em projetos de dados, sendo responsável por desenhar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis que suportem tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atividades do dia a dia:


Desenvolver e manter fluxos de ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados, garantindo que as informações estejam acessíveis, íntegras e atualizadas para os usuários de negócio.

Trabalhar em conjunto com analistas, cientistas de dados e equipes de negócio, compreendendo suas necessidades e traduzindo essas demandas em soluções de dados viáveis e eficientes.

Modelar dados estruturados e não estruturados, assegurando sua organização, governança e consistência ao longo dos projetos.

Garantir a qualidade dos dados, implementando processos de validação, auditoria e monitoramento contínuo.

Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à performance, falhas de pipeline e inconsistências nos dados, atuando de forma proativa para evitar recorrências.

Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio aplicadas nas soluções desenvolvidas, promovendo a transparência e facilitando a manutenção dos sistemas de dados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas e de alinhamento com stakeholders, comunicando de forma clara os avanços, riscos e limitações dos projetos em andamento.

Adaptar-se rapidamente a novos contextos e demandas, demonstrando curiosidade e iniciativa para aprender novas abordagens, padrões e boas práticas.


Python (Avançado )

SQL (Avançado )

PySpark (Avançado )

Databricks (Avançado )





TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Come to one of the largest IT services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make a difference, which is why we live in a culture of unlimited learning and full of opportunities for mutual improvement and development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer @ Remote - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career at TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES .

Job Description:

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Remote (Brazil)

Language Requirement : Fluent/Advanced English

Mandatory Skills:

  • Hands‑on AWS operations (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Azure operations experience (VMs, V Net, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB).
  • Strong troubleshooting & incident management (cloud, on‑prem, Linux/Windows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM, CDK).
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash).

Desirable Skills:

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies beyond basics (Docker + Kubernetes in production).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (routing, load balancing, security).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows focused on reliability, patching, backup & DR.
  • Ability to create and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Prior participation in on-call rotations and leading post‑incident reviews.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary) cloud environments.
  • Handle tickets, incidents, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
  • Maintain core AWS and Azure services, including computer, networking, security, and Kubernetes.
  • Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks.
  • Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS).
  • Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR.
  • Employment Type: (Permanent)



What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation voucher
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Childcare
  • Ginásio Pass
  • TCS Gems TCS Cares – toll-free 0800 that offers psychological (24 hours/day), legal, social and financial assistance to members
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online Courses & Live Training
  • Opportunity for international experience

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring your friend – By referring people, you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, always working for equity. This goes for Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We thought of different inclusion and social responsibility actions in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come be a TCSer!

title: Video Editor - Remote (Short-Form Ads)
description:
Video Editor & Graphic Designer


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Analista de Automação & IA Júnior/Pleno (Presencial)
description:
Quem somos

Somos um escritório de advocacia com atuação nacional e forte operação digital, atendendo milhares de clientes por mês.

Nosso crescimento é sustentado por automação, dados e inteligência artificial aplicada à operação real, integrando marketing, vendas e jurídico de forma estruturada e escalável. Aqui, IA não é discurso. É uma ferramenta diária de trabalho.


O que estamos buscando

Buscamos um profissional prático, executor, que já trabalhe com ferramentas modernas de automação e saiba conectar sistemas para fazer a operação rodar melhor, mais rápida e com menos erros.

Queremos alguém que saiba usar n8n, Make, Lovable, Cursor AI ou ferramentas similares na prática, tenha experiência com automação de CRM, utilize IA generativa para resolver problemas reais e que goste de testar, ajustar e otimizar fluxos.

Se você tem perfil “mão na massa”, é curioso(a), gosta de tecnologia aplicada e quer evoluir rápido, essa vaga é para você.


O desafio

Você atuará diretamente na construção, manutenção e otimização de automações ligadas à operação comercial e jurídica.

O foco não é desenvolver sistemas do zero, mas integrar, automatizar, estruturar fluxos e aplicar IA para ganho de escala e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades

Trabalhar com Lovable para construção de soluções rápidas e funcionais.

Automatizar processos dentro de CRM como Kommo ou similares.

Integrar sistemas via API REST e Webhooks em nível funcional.

Usar IA generativa como OpenAI e LLMs para classificação de leads, organização de dados e criação de mensagens automatizadas.

Monitorar automações, identificar falhas e corrigir rapidamente.

Propor melhorias com foco em escala, redução de erros e ganho de eficiência.


Requisitos

Experiência prática com n8n, Make, Lovable ou ferramentas similares.

Vivência com automação de CRM.

Entendimento funcional de APIs REST e Webhooks.

Conhecimento básico de banco de dados e SQL simples.

Perfil organizado, analítico e executor.

Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial em Brasília.


Diferenciais

Experiência com Lovable.

Vivência com Kommo, HubSpot ou Pipedrive.

Experiência com WhatsApp API.

Experiência aplicando IA em fluxos comerciais.

Noções básicas de lógica ou Node.js apenas para ajustes pontuais.


O que oferecemos

Remuneração de R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 7.000,00.

Reajuste após 3 meses conforme performance.

Aprendizado acelerado em IA aplicada a negócios reais.

Contato direto com decisões estratégicas.

Crescimento rápido para quem entrega.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Descrição Geral do Cargo:


Você vai projetar e evoluir soluções de IA generativa para uso real em negócio, com foco em agentes, prompting, RAG e avaliação. Procuramos alguém que saiba transformar necessidade em solução robusta, com guardrails, qualidade e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

• Desenhar agentes (agent workflows), ferramentas (tool calling) e prompts para casos de uso reais.

• Construir/evoluir pipelines de RAG (ingestão, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding).

• Definir guardrails e políticas: segurança, privacidade, compliance, prevenção de alucinação.

• Criar estratégia de avaliação: métricas, datasets, testes automatizados, critérios de aceite.

• Otimizar qualidade e custo (latência, contexto, taxas de erro, cache, roteamento de modelos).

• Trabalhar em parceria com engenharia para produção (logs, auditoria, monitoramento, versionamento).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues

  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership

  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: UI Designer (Part-time)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UX/UI Designer for a short-term contract (5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity) to support the design and evolution of a touch-first iPad application used by laboratory scientists to control equipment and analyze data in real time. The product is designed for non-expert users in lab environments and prioritizes speed, clarity, and reproducibility over visual complexity.


This engagement has two primary goals: defining UX for new feature development and supporting the adoption of updated iOS design guidelines.


Scope of Work:

New Feature Wireframes

You will define wireframes and UX flows for new features prior to development, ensuring alignment between product and engineering teams. These include:

  • A new navigation hub for multiple software modules, including clear handling of licensed vs. unlicensed states
  • A time-series data acquisition feature with configuration, live feedback, and playback for multi-dimensional datasets
  • Two new image analysis modules with consistent flows for launch, controls, results visualization, and save/discard actions
  • Enhancements to an existing analysis module to support additional configurations
  • A data export feature supporting multiple formats and destinations with error handling


iOS Design System Adoption

  • Review existing screens against updated iOS Human Interface Guidelines
  • Identify required updates for custom controls such as overlays, sliders, selectors, and timelines
  • Propose adaptations to align with new system design patterns while maintaining a professional, lab-focused interface
  • Ensure new designs are aligned with updated platform standards from the start


Expected Deliverables:

  • Annotated low- to mid-fidelity wireframes for all new feature flows, approved by the product
  • Design assessment and recommendations for updated iOS design system adoption
  • Final design files delivered in a format usable by the iOS development team


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX designer with robust experience designing for iPad applications.
  • Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad , including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization.
  • iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm.
  • Wireframing & Tools: Senior-level experience in producing annotated, implementation-ready wireframes using tools such as Figma or Sketch .
  • Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized; prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus.


Team Fit & Work Style:

  • Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams
  • Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environments


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software
  • Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystem


Engagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap.


Timeline: Project kick-off scheduled for early May


*Please note our partner is only looking for part-time dedicated team members who are eager to integrate within their team

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).

  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.

  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Analista de pré-vendas
description:
Sobre a vaga

A MySide iniciou sua jornada em 2019, a partir da insatisfação de seus fundadores com a experiência de compra de um imóvel no Brasil. O conceito é simples: enquanto corretores tradicionais trabalham para o vendedor, a MySide se dedica a defender apenas os seus interesses como comprador do imóvel. Por isso, nossa missão é ajudar quem busca um imóvel a fazer a melhor compra.

Como Analista de Pré-vendas (SDR), você será o primeiro contato \"humano\" com nossos clientes, com o objetivo de engajá-los na jornada de compra. Sua rotina envolverá a abordagem dos clientes através dos canais de comunicação (telefone e WhatsApp), educando-os sobre os principais conceitos que assegurem a melhor compra.

Estamos em busca de alguém que esteja disposto a aprender e se sinta motivado a fazer o negócio acontecer, e não apenas \"bater o ponto\". Em contrapartida, por se tratar de uma startup, você terá autonomia e a oportunidade de vivenciar a realidade da construção de um negócio de alto potencial desde sua fundação.

Se você se identifica com esse propósito e está disposto a crescer conosco, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Curso superior em andamento ou concluído;

  • Disponibilidade no horário de trabalho das 9:12 até 19:00;

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de aplicações web para a área de pós vendas,

Front-end: React e Next.js com Chakra UI, aplicando boas práticas de componentização e responsividade Back-end: Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços em NestJS, executando sobre Node.js

Experiencia com TypeScript, com sólida base em JavaScript

Diferencial: Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e bancos de dados PostgreSQL


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Data Engineer (GraphQL / AWS)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (GraphQL / AWS)

Location: Remote

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in building scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layers to deliver high-volume sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms.

In this role, you will design and implement robust data systems, enabling seamless data ingestion, processing, and delivery. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build a federated GraphQL architecture , powering next-generation sports data experiences within the digital ecosystem.


Key Projects

  • Build a unified GraphQL API layer for seamless data access across platforms
  • Design and implement a core data platform for CBS Sports Digital products
  • Develop data pipelines integrating multiple sources and transport mechanisms
  • Implement distributed tracing systems for enhanced observability
  • Containerize services to improve scalability and reduce infrastructure overhead


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or distributed data systems
  • Strong experience with GraphQL schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning
  • Proficiency in:
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Python
  • Node.js
  • Experience with databases:
  • Relational (e.g., Aurora MySQL)
  • NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB)
  • Key-value stores (e.g., Redis)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services in high-traffic environments
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, GitOps, and testing frameworks
  • Experience designing scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Apollo GraphQL, WunderGraph, or Cosmo
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience building ETL pipelines and working with orchestration tools
  • Background in digital media, sports, or content platforms
  • Knowledge of sports data or gaming/betting systems

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.
