title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Scrum Master & Project Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Vaga 1: SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager

Vaga 2: SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration

Remote | CLT | Long-term engagement

Orientações importantes para candidatura

Este processo seletivo contempla duas vagas distintas dentro do mesmo Projeto Global SAP liderado pela Tech Mahindra .

Antes de se candidatar , leia atentamente os perfis descritos abaixo e identifique qual vaga está mais alinhada à sua experiência profissional .

Como se candidatar corretamente:

  • Escolha a vaga compatível com o seu perfil
  • Vaga 1: SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager
  • Vaga 2: SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration
  • Inscreva-se normalmente pelo link da vaga .
  • No momento de enviar o currículo, informe claramente no título do arquivo do CV o nome da vaga escolhida , por exemplo:
  • CV – SAP S/4HANA Program Project Cutover Release Manager – Nome Sobrenome
  • CV – SAP Scrum Master Ariba S/4HANA – Nome Sobrenome

Essa identificação é essencial para que seu perfil seja avaliado corretamente pelo time recrutador.

Importante: Caso você entenda que seu perfil seja aderente a apenas uma das vagas , inscreva-se indicando somente a posição correspondente . Cada vaga possui escopo, responsabilidades e requisitos específicos.

Perfil 1 – SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager

✦ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar programas e projetos SAP S/4HANA end-to-end , garantindo governança, planejamento, execução e entrega.
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de Cutover e Go‑Live , incluindo mock cutovers, dress rehearsals, gestão de riscos, dependências e planos de contingência.
  • Gerenciar Release Management, contemplando calendário de releases, transportes e ambientes (DEV, QA, UAT, PRD), assegurando qualidade e controle.
  • Atuar como ponto central de decisão durante Go‑Live e Hypercare, garantindo a continuidade do negócio.
  • Conduzir a comunicação com stakeholders globais, negócio, TI, SAP e partners, incluindo fóruns executivos e reports de status.
  • Garantir qualidade, compliance, estratégia de testes e melhoria contínua em ambientes SAP globais.

✦ Requisitos Esperados

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência sólida em implementações ou conversões SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield, Brownfield ou ECC → S/4HANA).
  • Vivência comprovada liderando Cutover, Go‑Live e Hypercare em programas SAP de grande porte.
  • Bom entendimento de módulos SAP como FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM, Ariba (não é necessário dominar todos).
  • Experiência com SAP Activate, Agile ou modelos híbridos de delivery.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Certificações como PMP, PgMP ou PRINCE2 são altamente desejáveis.

Perfil 2 – SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration

✦ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Scrum Master em times SAP focados em SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying.
  • Orquestrar Buying Channels (Guided Buying, Catálogos, Spot Buy), regras de aprovação e políticas de compra.
  • Coordenar integrações entre SAP Ariba e SAP S/4HANA , incluindo fluxos de compras, faturamento, impostos, fornecedores e contabilidade.
  • Facilitar cerimônias Agile, remover impedimentos e garantir previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com áreas como Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Security, Master Data e fornecedores externos.
  • Assegurar aderência a SOX, GxP e requisitos de auditoria, especialmente em ambientes corporativos regulados.
  • Apoiar fases de hypercare, estabilização, planejamento de releases e melhoria contínua.

✦ Requisitos Esperados

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, com atuação em Ariba.
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay.
  • Vivência com SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying , catálogos e workflows de aprovação.
  • Entendimento de integrações Ariba–S/4HANA (CPI, APIs, IDocs).
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos globais, complexos ou regulados.
  • Certificações Agile (CSM, PSM, SAFe) são diferenciais.

title: Video Editor - Remote (Short-Form Ads)
description:
Video Editor & Graphic Designer


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: UI Designer (Part-time)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UX/UI Designer for a short-term contract (5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity) to support the design and evolution of a touch-first iPad application used by laboratory scientists to control equipment and analyze data in real time. The product is designed for non-expert users in lab environments and prioritizes speed, clarity, and reproducibility over visual complexity.


This engagement has two primary goals: defining UX for new feature development and supporting the adoption of updated iOS design guidelines.


Scope of Work:

New Feature Wireframes

You will define wireframes and UX flows for new features prior to development, ensuring alignment between product and engineering teams. These include:

  • A new navigation hub for multiple software modules, including clear handling of licensed vs. unlicensed states
  • A time-series data acquisition feature with configuration, live feedback, and playback for multi-dimensional datasets
  • Two new image analysis modules with consistent flows for launch, controls, results visualization, and save/discard actions
  • Enhancements to an existing analysis module to support additional configurations
  • A data export feature supporting multiple formats and destinations with error handling


iOS Design System Adoption

  • Review existing screens against updated iOS Human Interface Guidelines
  • Identify required updates for custom controls such as overlays, sliders, selectors, and timelines
  • Propose adaptations to align with new system design patterns while maintaining a professional, lab-focused interface
  • Ensure new designs are aligned with updated platform standards from the start


Expected Deliverables:

  • Annotated low- to mid-fidelity wireframes for all new feature flows, approved by the product
  • Design assessment and recommendations for updated iOS design system adoption
  • Final design files delivered in a format usable by the iOS development team


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX designer with robust experience designing for iPad applications.
  • Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad , including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization.
  • iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm.
  • Wireframing & Tools: Senior-level experience in producing annotated, implementation-ready wireframes using tools such as Figma or Sketch .
  • Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized; prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus.


Team Fit & Work Style:

  • Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams
  • Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environments


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software
  • Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystem


Engagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap.


Timeline: Project kick-off scheduled for early May


*Please note our partner is only looking for part-time dedicated team members who are eager to integrate within their team

title: Desenvolvedor Back End Java
description:
Back End Java Developer Description

The ideal candidate for this role will have at least four years of experience building Java applications, most recently within a microservices architecture. Preferably, you will have a strong understanding of DevOps and deployment procedures within an AWS environment. However, any experience with containerization and continuous integration would be beneficial. Streaming protocols for VOD and live streaming technologies are bonus points!


The candidate will have a strong understanding and experience building Rest APIs, streaming protocols, and Microservices, often integrating with third-party software. They primarily focus on streaming solutions, digital security, and automation, working with Java 11, Spring Boot, AWS Lambdas, Docker, and CI/CD.


This is an opportunity to grow into a Lead or Principal engineer while working on some of the most complex solutions for the media and entertainment business.


Preferred Technical Skills for reference

- Programming: Languages Java, Python

- Operating systems: Linux, Windows 10, Mac OS

- Development Tools: Intellij Idea, VS Code, Vim

- Networking: REST, MQTT, gRPC, XMPP

- Technologies: Spring, Spring Boot, JPA, Liquibase, Querydsl, PostgresSQL, Redis, Hadoop, HBase, Apache Phoenix, Apache Spark, AWS SDK, Maven, Gradle, Git, Docker

- English Advance

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Full-Stack Senior PHP Developer
description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Scrum Master & Project Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Vaga 1: SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager

Vaga 2: SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration

Remote | CLT | Long-term engagement

Orientações importantes para candidatura

Este processo seletivo contempla duas vagas distintas dentro do mesmo Projeto Global SAP liderado pela Tech Mahindra .

Antes de se candidatar , leia atentamente os perfis descritos abaixo e identifique qual vaga está mais alinhada à sua experiência profissional .

Como se candidatar corretamente:

  • Escolha a vaga compatível com o seu perfil
  • Vaga 1: SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager
  • Vaga 2: SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration
  • Inscreva-se normalmente pelo link da vaga .
  • No momento de enviar o currículo, informe claramente no título do arquivo do CV o nome da vaga escolhida , por exemplo:
  • CV – SAP S/4HANA Program Project Cutover Release Manager – Nome Sobrenome
  • CV – SAP Scrum Master Ariba S/4HANA – Nome Sobrenome

Essa identificação é essencial para que seu perfil seja avaliado corretamente pelo time recrutador.

Importante: Caso você entenda que seu perfil seja aderente a apenas uma das vagas , inscreva-se indicando somente a posição correspondente . Cada vaga possui escopo, responsabilidades e requisitos específicos.

Perfil 1 – SAP S/4HANA Program / Project / Cutover / Release Manager

✦ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar programas e projetos SAP S/4HANA end-to-end , garantindo governança, planejamento, execução e entrega.
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de Cutover e Go‑Live , incluindo mock cutovers, dress rehearsals, gestão de riscos, dependências e planos de contingência.
  • Gerenciar Release Management, contemplando calendário de releases, transportes e ambientes (DEV, QA, UAT, PRD), assegurando qualidade e controle.
  • Atuar como ponto central de decisão durante Go‑Live e Hypercare, garantindo a continuidade do negócio.
  • Conduzir a comunicação com stakeholders globais, negócio, TI, SAP e partners, incluindo fóruns executivos e reports de status.
  • Garantir qualidade, compliance, estratégia de testes e melhoria contínua em ambientes SAP globais.

✦ Requisitos Esperados

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência sólida em implementações ou conversões SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield, Brownfield ou ECC → S/4HANA).
  • Vivência comprovada liderando Cutover, Go‑Live e Hypercare em programas SAP de grande porte.
  • Bom entendimento de módulos SAP como FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM, Ariba (não é necessário dominar todos).
  • Experiência com SAP Activate, Agile ou modelos híbridos de delivery.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Certificações como PMP, PgMP ou PRINCE2 são altamente desejáveis.

Perfil 2 – SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration

✦ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Scrum Master em times SAP focados em SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying.
  • Orquestrar Buying Channels (Guided Buying, Catálogos, Spot Buy), regras de aprovação e políticas de compra.
  • Coordenar integrações entre SAP Ariba e SAP S/4HANA , incluindo fluxos de compras, faturamento, impostos, fornecedores e contabilidade.
  • Facilitar cerimônias Agile, remover impedimentos e garantir previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com áreas como Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Security, Master Data e fornecedores externos.
  • Assegurar aderência a SOX, GxP e requisitos de auditoria, especialmente em ambientes corporativos regulados.
  • Apoiar fases de hypercare, estabilização, planejamento de releases e melhoria contínua.

✦ Requisitos Esperados

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, com atuação em Ariba.
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay.
  • Vivência com SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying , catálogos e workflows de aprovação.
  • Entendimento de integrações Ariba–S/4HANA (CPI, APIs, IDocs).
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos globais, complexos ou regulados.
  • Certificações Agile (CSM, PSM, SAFe) são diferenciais.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

  • Avaliar, com suporte e orientação, crédito para novos clientes, através do levantamento e análise de documentações, referências comerciais e informações financeiras dos clientes (ex. balanço patrimonial, DRE e fluxo de caixa), visando assegurar uma avaliação consistente e evitar inadimplência.
  • Realizar a classificação de risco de crédito (rating), validar com seu superior imediato, recomendar limites de crédito e encaminhar para análise da seguradora.
  • Analisar limites de crédito definido pela seguradora e inserir a validação de liberação de crédito no cadastro dos clientes.
  • Emitir Relatório de Rating dos clientes.
  • Realizar o processo para revisão de limite de crédito para os clientes e validar junto ao seu superior imediato.
  • Acompanhar e analisar status de ordens bloqueadas para faturamento, a fim de identificar e avaliar as informações que estejam impactando na liberação, bem como atuar nas ações necessárias para desbloqueio.
  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.

Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e sistemas de análise de crédito (ex.: relatórios Serasa, balanço financeiro) que permite avaliar e analisar riscos de crédito;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de cobrança, técnicas de negociação e em matemática financeira (ex.: cálculos de juros/encargos, projeções de crédito e caixa);
  • Vivência em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária(licença maternidade);
  • Diferencial: experiência com o sistema SAP.

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva II
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!

Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!

Sua energia será muito importante para:

Responsável por executar as manutenções e operações das linhas de transmissão e subestações do sistema elétrico da Coelba, segundo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade, confiabilidade, segurança e a continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica em todo o estado da Bahia.

Atividades:

  • Trabalhar em conformidade com procedimentos e manual de conduta;
  • Executar tarefas de suporte administrativo/de escritório em um ambiente de escritório, campo ou local;
  • Execução das inspeções visuais, termográficas, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nos ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Garantir a qualidade das intervenções por meio da execução de serviços de manuseio, transporte de carga/descarga de equipamentos e materiais de uso na manutenção;
  • Assegurar melhorias de qualidade em subestações e linhas por meio do auxílio na execução de obras CAPEX e OPEX nessas instalações;
  • Reduzir tempo e número de interrupções fortuitas através de serviços de apoio a outras áreas, associados a operação e manutenção em linhas de subtransmissão e distribuição;
  • Acompanhamento diário dos registros de eventos de relés digitais e identificação e correção de falhas em ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Coordenar trabalhos de campo, dirigir viaturas, planejar atividades, interpretar projetos, relatórios e relatórios da ordem de serviço, realizar acompanhamento das obras em campo, orientar sobre risco de acidente, prestar suporte de socorro em caso de acidente, e ou problemas de saúde, realizar integração / DSS com sua equipe;
  • Elaborar planos operacionais, colaborando com sugestões, fazendo mudanças de funções , delegando atividades e supervisionando o trabalho das equipes;
  • Desenvolver a sua equipe de maneira a promover o crescimento profissional e intelectual de cada membro.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Formação de Linha Viva em Subtransmissão;
  • Experiência com linha viva 13.8 kv até 138kv;
  • Cursos de NR 10 básico, NR 10 SEP, NR 35 e Redes de Distribuição;
  • Carteira de Habilitação D;
  • Pacote office - nível básico;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade de Feira de Santana/ BA.

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!;
  • Licença maternidade estendida, para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença paternidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos, porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos;
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.

Quer saber mais sobre a Neoenergia? Acompanhe as nossas redes sociais!

#VemSerNeoenergia #OrgulhodeSerNeoenergia

title: Gerente de Negócios
description:
Edenred é uma plataforma digital líder em serviços e pagamentos e a companhia diária para as pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 850.000 clientes corporativos, 50 milhões de usuários, 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros em 44 países por meio de 4 linhas de negócios:

• MOVE: Gestão de Combustível e Frota, Frete, Manutenção, Pedágio

• EAT & CARE: Refeições e Alimentos, Cultura, Incentivos & Recompensas e Saúde

• PAY: Gestão de despesas, pagamento de salários e comissões para trabalhadores independentes e prestadores de serviços

• ACQUIRING: soluções para comerciantes

Estamos no centro de uma rede virtuosa que agrega valor aos seus clientes:

• Empresas e setor público, preocupados em ser empregadores atraentes, motivando suas equipes e otimizando seu desempenho

• Funcionários e cidadãos, que apreciam a simplicidade e conveniência de nossas soluções de pagamento para tornar suas vidas mais fáceis

• Comerciantes (restaurantes, lojas, postos de gasolina, etc.) que buscam aumentar sua receita, fidelizar seus clientes e tornar suas transações mais seguras

Nossos 12.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos, mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar

Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo. Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionários. Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos

Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor

Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você!

Missão do cargo

Responsável por prospectar novos clientes (empresas), criar e alimentar pipeline de oportunidades e conduzir o processo de venda desde a abordagem inicial até o fechamento, com foco em bater metas comerciais.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa de clientes (cadastros frios, mapeamento de mercado, cold calls, LinkedIn, networking).
  • Identificação de leads qualificados seguindo critérios de perfil ideal (segmento, porte, potencial).
  • Realização de reuniões presenciais e virtuais com decisores para apresentar soluções da Ticket Log.
  • Elaboração e negociação de propostas comerciais conforme diretrizes de pricing.
  • Gestão do funil de vendas (pipeline) e uso de CRM para registro de todas as interações, status de oportunidades, follow-ups etc.
  • Acompanhamento de todo o ciclo de venda: desde prospecção até a assinatura de contrato, entrega de documentação e ativação.
  • Atuação colaborativa com equipes internas (marketing, operações, implementação) para garantir o cumprimento de expectativas do cliente.
  • Monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e participação no planejamento de metas comerciais.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa (Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais, Negócios ou áreas afins).
  • Experiência prévia comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente com perfil "hunter" (prospecção ativa).
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas (ex: SPIN, Challenger, venda por valor).
  • Habilidade de negociação e comunicação com stakeholders de diferentes níveis.
  • Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Pipedrive ou similares).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e foco em resultados.
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos, reuniões em campo e viagens constantes.
  • Desejável conhecimento no segmento de frotas, mobilidade ou cartões corporativos.
  • Inglês /intermediário será diferencial

O que esperamos?

Buscamos um profissional com perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a resultados e com habilidade para trabalhar autonomamente. Que goste de desafios, tenha boa capacidade analítica e saiba lidar com pressão e metas agressivas.

title: Plant Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic Plant Manager to lead our manufacturing operations in Bahía. This role is pivotal in driving operational excellence, ensuring safety, and delivering strong financial performance. You will oversee production processes, optimize efficiency, and inspire a team of around 500 associates to achieve ambitious goals while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the future of manufacturing by developing and executing strategic plans that boost efficiency, productivity, and overall performance.
  • Lead with impact by managing a diverse team of managers, supervisors, and production staff, empowering them to grow and succeed.
  • Drive results through clear KPIs, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and operational goals are consistently met.
  • Collaborate across functions with engineering, supply chain, and quality teams to deliver seamless production processes.
  • Champion safety by enforcing rigorous protocols and creating a safe, supportive environment for all associates.
  • Innovate boldly by introducing new technologies, automation, and lean methodologies to enhance operations.
  • Own the numbers by managing budgets, reducing costs, and ensuring strong financial outcomes for the site.
  • Invest in the future by designing long-term strategies for talent, equipment, and capital investments.
  • Inspire growth by mentoring plant leadership, promoting teamwork, and building a culture of accountability and excellence.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience in manufacturing management, with at least 10 years in the field and 3+ years overseeing multiple departments.
  • Strong background in budget management, cost analysis, and resource allocation.
  • Expertise in lean manufacturing, operational excellence (OPEX), and process optimization.
  • Experience leading operations in Brazil, with deep knowledge of regulatory and safety standards.
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Exceptional communication, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Analista de transporte
description:
Analista de Transporte Júnior

Local: Região Sudeste

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Área: Logística / Transporte

Objetivo da Função

Apoiar a operação de transporte, garantindo acompanhamento eficiente das transportadoras, cumprimento dos prazos de coleta, carregamento e entrega, além de assegurar comunicação clara entre as áreas envolvidas.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

  • Realizar o monitoramento diário das transportadoras, acompanhando desde a chegada para carregamento até a entrega ao cliente.
  • Acompanhar horários de chegada, início de carregamento e saída dos veículos.
  • Monitorar o status das entregas e garantir atualizações precisas para os setores envolvidos.
  • Manter contato direto com transportadoras para alinhamento de demandas, tratativa de ocorrências e melhoria dos processos.
  • Registrar informações de transporte em planilhas e sistemas internos.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas para alinhamento de informações e fluxo de operação.
  • Auxiliar no controle de indicadores de transporte e desempenho das transportadoras.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Ensino Superior cursando ou concluído em Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas de transporte ou transportadoras (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Excel (básico a intermediário);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação entre diferentes áreas.

Competências Desejáveis

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Agilidade na resolução de problemas;
  • Perfil colaborativo e proativo;
  • Raciocínio lógico e boa análise de informações operacionais.

title: Lubrificador
description:
Requisitos:

Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica e áreas correlatas;

Experiência em manutenção industrial;

Conhecimento nos tipos e aplicações de graxas e lubrificantes industriais;

Conhecimento em Técnicas de lubrificação (manual, com bomba, centralizada);

Conhecimento em Leitura de manuais técnicos e planos de lubrificação.

Atividades:

Realizar a lubrificação de máquinas, equipamentos e componentes mecânicos, conforme plano de manutenção;

Verificar níveis e realizar abastecimento ou troca de óleos, graxas e outros lubrificantes;

Executar o engaxetamento de bombas e equipamentos, substituindo gaxetas e assegurando vedação adequada;

Preencher checklists e registros de controle das atividades realizadas;

Realizar inspeções visuais para identificar vazamentos, falhas ou desgastes anormais;

Manusear, transportar e armazenar lubrificantes com segurança e de acordo com normas internas;

Zelar pela limpeza dos pontos de lubrificação e realizar descarte adequado de resíduos;

Apoiar a equipe de manutenção nos serviços de rotina, quando necessário. Realizar as atividades da sua função conforme as normas técnicas, procedimentos da qualidade, limpeza, organização, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.
Planejar sprints, gerenciar o fluxo de tarefas e acompanhar a evolução técnica dos desenvolvedores.
Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.
Atuar ativamente no código (Full Stack) para acelerar desenvolvimentos críticos ou resolver gargalos técnicos da equipe. Qualificações
Habilidade em planejamento de desenvolvimento de software, gestão de desenvolvedores e garantia de entregas.
Sólida experiência como Desenvolvedor Full Stack.
Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).
Visão de testes e qualidade de código.
Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.
Comunicação clara para alinhar expectativas com a equipe de desenvolvimento e stakeholders.
Perfil de dono: você assume a responsabilidade de amarrar todas as pontas do projeto para garantir o sucesso final. Desejável
Experiência prévia atuando como Tech Lead ou liderando equipes técnicas.
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos de startups e metodologias ágeis.
Noções de negócios e produto. Diferencial da Vaga

Você receberá bonus percentual atrelado com o lucro líquido dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Uma excelente oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento e ter impacto direto na qualidade e no sucesso dos produtos que construímos.

description:

Location: Remote
Language : Portuguese-Brazilian
Job Type: Contingent (Hourly/Project-Based)

The objective of this project is to have human evaluators listen to short audio clips of AI-generated speech (~30 seconds each) and correct the corresponding transcriptions. Strong linguistic and transcription expertise
Familiarity with medical terminology in the language Portuguese-Brazilian
High attention to detail and accuracy in transcription Proficiency:
L3 with strong medical transcription experience Education Background:
Medical background or degree preferred Work Experience:
Previous transcription experience, ideally in medical or healthcare-related projects

Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.
Planejar sprints, gerenciar o fluxo de tarefas e acompanhar a evolução técnica dos desenvolvedores.
Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.
Atuar ativamente no código (Full Stack) para acelerar desenvolvimentos críticos ou resolver gargalos técnicos da equipe. Qualificações
Habilidade em planejamento de desenvolvimento de software, gestão de desenvolvedores e garantia de entregas.
Sólida experiência como Desenvolvedor Full Stack.
Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).
Visão de testes e qualidade de código.
Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.
Comunicação clara para alinhar expectativas com a equipe de desenvolvimento e stakeholders.
Perfil de dono: você assume a responsabilidade de amarrar todas as pontas do projeto para garantir o sucesso final. Desejável
Experiência prévia atuando como Tech Lead ou liderando equipes técnicas.
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos de startups e metodologias ágeis.
Noções de negócios e produto. Diferencial da Vaga
Modelo de Parceria nos Resultados: Além da remuneração, você receberá bônus atrelados à performance dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Você receberá bonus percentual atrelado com o lucro líquido dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Uma excelente oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento e ter impacto direto na qualidade e no sucesso dos produtos que construímos.

Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills

Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs

Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program

Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
